To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, elements from the hip-hop genre can be integrated by designing visual installations that mimic the rhythmic, syncopated beats of hip-hop tracks. The artwork could feature fragmented, layered imagery that reflects the genre's characteristic lyrical flow, creating a visual rhythm that parallels the energetic and gritty atmosphere of city living. Additionally, the use of bold, contrasting colors and dynamic, jagged lines in the art pieces can echo the raw energy and assertive tone often found in hip-hop production, thereby creating a cohesive sensory experience that unites the visual and auditory elements of the exhibition.
